subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear in source, but schema, span parenting, low-cardinality reason taxonomy, and redaction rules are public observability-contract choices.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate existing run/span only
options.body: Attach the death reason to an existing run or sessions_spawn-related span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths after the spawn tool call has returned.

options.title: Fold into broader dispatch telemetry
options.body: Defer this to the broader dispatch landing telemetry design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76247, accepting that subagent death clustering remains blind until that lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and export it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined history signal is subagent registry lifecycle ownership plus recent diagnostic/audit event work touching stable runtime metadata.
